title: Public Data Set Schema

tags.description: Data kind and domain tags for discoverability (e.g. policy, tariff, program, prosumer, grid, billing)

data_url.description: URL where the dataset is hosted

data_inline.description: The dataset itself, embedded inline as a string (base64-encoded for binary formats, raw text for CSV/JSON/XML)

description.description: What this dataset contains and its intended use

data_url_checksum.description: Hash value of the data at data_url

description: Schema for publishing public datasets on DeDi. Supports both inline data and external data referenced by URL with integrity verification via checksum.
